documents.title: Project Charter
documents.approval_policy: Project sponsor / project manager approval; project identity and baseline scope are human-controlled.

documents.title: Project Plan
documents.approval_policy: Timeline, resource allocation and approved commitments require owner confirmation.

documents.title: Software Requirements Specification (SRS)
documents.approval_policy: AI may propose requirements from evidence; product owner confirms requirement baselines.

documents.title: Business Requirement Document (BRD)
documents.approval_policy: Do not infer financial or commercial outcomes from code changes.

documents.title: Functional Specification
documents.approval_policy: Derive implemented behavior from code, tests and report; distinguish planned from implemented.

documents.title: Technical Specification
documents.approval_policy: Require code, migrations, API definitions or explicit report evidence for technical claims.

documents.title: Architecture Document
documents.approval_policy: Only change architecture where repository evidence demonstrates a structural change.

documents.title: UI / UX Design Document
documents.approval_policy: Do not invent screens, design specifications or accessibility validation.

documents.title: Sprint Plan
documents.approval_policy: Sprint assignments, capacity and commitments require project-management source data.

documents.title: Test Plan
documents.approval_policy: Testing strategy may be proposed; test completion must be backed by execution evidence.

documents.title: Test Cases
documents.approval_policy: Generate candidate cases; actual result and status require test-run evidence.

documents.title: UAT Sign-off
documents.approval_policy: Never create or imply business-owner acceptance or signatures.

documents.title: Deployment Checklist
documents.approval_policy: Only mark steps complete when deployment evidence exists.

documents.title: Go-Live Checklist
documents.approval_policy: Go/no-go and sign-off are always human decisions.

documents.title: Maintenance Plan
documents.approval_policy: SLA, contacts, escalation owners and schedules require authorized source data.

sections: 2. How It Is Done — Execution Approach
master_record.policy: Update only from explicitly authorized project-management/HR/finance records; never infer personal, asset or financial data from source code.
